Matches must begin at alphanumeric tokens, i.e., 'util.Sorted' matches 'java.util.SortedSet' but not 'myutil.SortedArray'. The filter matches if all filter terms match. All non-alphanumeric characters are ignored for matching. Filtering is assumed to be prefix-search and order-independent unless phrases are surrounded by "".
